subject: What needs another look?
preheader: If a bed, mattress or overnight setup is not quite right, bring it back to us.
intro: You have worked with us before, so this is not an introduction to home trials.
It is a simple check-in. If a setup has changed, stopped working as expected or a new client brief is becoming complicated, David and Alex want to hear about it.
sectionTitle: The work does not finish at delivery
body: The real test begins when the equipment is used at home. Needs change. A configuration may need adjustment. A new brief may also depend on what was learned from the last one.
We can help review the setup, arrange another trial or work through the next bed and mattress decision with you.
questions: A previous setup needs adjustment or review.
A new bed or mattress brief needs a home trial.
Several pieces of equipment need to work together.
actionTitle: What are you working on now?
actionText: Reply with a few details about the person's needs, what is not working and what has changed. David or Alex will come back to you and work through the most useful next step.
teamName: The Sleep Choice x Supply Ministry Team
trialFooterText: Seven-night in-home trial availability, service area, equipment configuration and individual arrangements are confirmed per case.
